newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FIRST FREE ECONOMIC ZONE TO START IN NOVEMBER.
newsitem.headline: FIRST FREE ECONOMIC ZONE TO START IN NOVEMBER.

text.p: The first free economic zone in Estonia was given a green light on Tuesday when the government approved a regulation on customs control in the zones.
"There is a green light to form the free zone in Muuga port from November 1," the Economics Minister Jaak Leimann told a news conference.
Leimann added that if the first free zone is a success, the government will consider setting up additional ones in other ports or areas.
The minister said the zone will hopefully boost transit trade and turnover.
